biggest_catch: Prolific's official page promises PayPal cash-out at $6/£6 (instant after the first 4 cash-outs), but there is no official deadline for researcher approval of completed studies and no official per-study payout — earnings sit pending until a researcher approves.
catches: No official researcher-approval deadline; earnings stay pending until approval.
No official per-study payout or study-duration figures.
Studies fill fast; availability depends on demographics and researcher targeting.
New participants wait for their first $6/£6 to unlock cash-out.

c1.evidence: Official participants page confirms a cash-out program: 'Once you've earned at least $6/£6, you can cash out directly from your Prolific account... After your first 4 cashouts, payments are instantly transferred to your PayPal.' (prolific.com/participants)

c2.evidence: No official per-study payout or minimum rate is stated on the participants page.

c3.evidence: No official approval deadline, so same-day payout cannot be confirmed.

c4.evidence: No upfront fee; participants are paid.

eligibility: Must sign up, complete the profile, and be matched to studies; slots fill first-come-first-served
maximize: Treat Prolific as queue-dependent research income, not fast cash — only studies whose posted details you accept are worth your time, and never assume researcher approval arrives the same day.
notes: Official page (prolific.com/participants) fetched 2026-09-23. Cash-out mechanics exist, but no official approval deadline or per-study payout is stated — the reject rests on those official gaps.

s2.note: Official cash-out timing stated; no approval deadline.

s3.note: Eligibility stated officially: profile, matching, first-come-first-served.

s4.note: No fee; cash out via PayPal.

s5.note: Flow documented: match, complete, wait for approval, cash out.

s6.note: Pay terms visible per study; no general official range.

s7.note: Studies by invitation; scarce and competitive.
